title: Fix sub-core hub Recent activity layout
summary: Restores full-width Recent activity rows on APES CIC, Shelter and Rescue, and Pet Care Clinic hub pages by aligning hub markup with the dashboard attention-item grid.
changes: Added a shared attention-item link component with icon, body, meta, and chevron columns used by the dashboard and sub-core hubs.
Mapped hub recent-activity module types to the correct icon and style modifiers, including pet-profile rows.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch release fixing a pre-existing layout regression where hub recent activity content was squashed into the icon column.
validation: Focused hub recent-activity layout tests, dashboard attention tests, composer test, npm run build, and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: This patch does not change authorization, data, or module query behavior.
rollback: Revert this patch record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, and the shared attention-item component changes. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the sub-core Recent activity layout fix for MyAPES Account issue #64 and pull request #65.
